rules.rule: Preserve merged EA DTM1m/DTM2m measurements only when recorded WCS response SHA256 and exact HMLR hash chain remain present
Do not treat support-only National LIDAR independent intersection as canonical queue-v6.1 acceptance
Do not infer National LIDAR target feature from TQ tile name or service extent; exact returned feature remains optional supplemental evidence
OS Terrain50 numeric crosscheck requires actual current ZIP/ASCII bytes and selected grid member; URL or version page alone is insufficient
OS Terrain50 sample must use documented pixel-centre semantics and prepared row/column for TQ39 TQ59 TQ27
Current runtime DNS failure is transport failure, not NO_DATA and not evidence of source absence
Prior Chromium localhost 8012 PASS may be preserved as historical browser evidence but may not satisfy current existing-F-host 1036-floor acceptance
Canonical status remains 340/381 and 78 percent until existing F-host receipt/claim/output acceptance is remotely verified
No second task, runner, owner takeover or parallel daemon is allowed
No new numeric value may be created from documentation, tile centres, interpolation or unsupported inference
